title: Fix Windows x86_64 release qualification test gates in harvest, runtime lifecycle, and http_wire
goal: Fix Windows backslash path slug extraction in xtask/src/harvest.rs default_slug_from_url, suppress Windows error dialogs and extend child probe budget in crates/susi-windows-runtime/tests/fixtures/driver.rs so __fastfail abort probes complete deterministically under load, and switch crates/susi-harness/src/tests/http_wire.rs exchange() to split async TcpStream I/O so unconsumed >2 MiB payloads never deadlock Winsock send buffers.
